body:
The round76 publication helper `reviews/publication/20261014-round76/helper-tools/cmm-round76-hosted-audit-paginated.py` still starts its `pagination_correction` receipt text with “Round75 reuses”. It was inherited by a literal round75→round76 filename/base adaptation because the replacement was case-sensitive. The same text correctly says that no round76 first-100-file failure is asserted, and all operational guards use the current round76 identity.

Severity: minor provenance wording. This is not a pagination, record-science, queue or cleanup defect. The independent helper audit identified the stale description before publication or helper execution.

Acceptance: preserve the initial audit and exact pre-correction checksum; replace only the stale descriptive round label with Round76; retain a before/after correction receipt; verify the repository helper copy matches the executable temporary helper and the AST excluding that string is unchanged; obtain a successor independent static disposition. Keep earlier derivation and review observations immutable. No scientific owner/history change is needed.
title: Correct stale round label in round76 publication audit provenance
